plugins.name: gh
plugins.description: GitHub and git workflow skills. /gh:sync moves a checkout to its default branch, fast-forwards it, and prunes branches whose work has already landed. /gh:shepherd merges a repo's auto-merge-enabled dependencies PRs one at a time.

plugins.name: field-test
plugins.description: Plugin quality assurance. /field-test:run runs a skill or command under observation and files one reproducible issue per problem; /field-test:harden loops that over a list of repositories and drives each round through fix, review, and merge until the skill is clean.

plugins.name: mermaid
plugins.description: Mermaid diagram previews. /mermaid:view shares a mermaid.live or mermaid.ink link for a diagram whenever one is written, edited, or reviewed.

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: /audit:context audits a repository's CLAUDE.md, README.md and .claude/**/*.md for rot: references that no longer resolve, statements whose named condition has ended, duplicated claims.

plugins.name: typescript7-lsp
plugins.description: TypeScript 7 language server. Runs the project's own TypeScript 7 native language server (tsc --lsp --stdio) for go to definition, find references, hover types and diagnostics, in place of typescript-lsp, which fails on TypeScript 7 because it ships no tsserver.
